fusions.name: Decree Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 30 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range; allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds after it hits.

fusions.name: Parade Pair
fusions.desc: Fires 2 rounds side by side; each round deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Raise the Standard
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Executive Order
fusions.desc: Against enemies at low health, you deal 15% more damage.
